facts.value: UL faculty must ensure that the receiving institution is a university with whom the University of Limerick has a signed 'inter-institutional' agreement.
Applicants should check with UL Global prior to submitting their application to ensure the institution to which they are considering travelling holds a valid mobility agreement with UL.
The funded duration for staff mobility must be a minimum of 2 days (excluding travel).
The funded duration for staff mobility must be a maximum of 7 days (including travel).
UL faculty attending a partner institution must fulfil a minimum of 8 teaching hours per week during their mobility.
